The *Dhotakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 406) is a biographical verse text located in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the spiritual lineage and past meritorious actions of the elder Dhotaka, and is noted in connection with the *Mūgapakkhajātaka* (Ja 538) [SuttaCentral]. The text has five translations across five modern languages indexed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

While SuttaCentral records no direct curated cross-canonical parallels [SuttaCentral], DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal text reuse, calculating 153 matches across 22 Pali works [DharmaNexus]. The largest concentrations of matching text occur in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo and Dutiyo bhāgo, particularly around segments §13.1–15.0) and other Apadāna poems such as the *Jatukaṇṇittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 411, segments §25.2–28.3), *Bhaddālittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 413), *Ajitattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 402), and *Upasivattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 407) [DharmaNexus].
